tools.name: get_pcb_quote
tools.description: Get a tiered PCB manufacturing quote from pcb.dog. USD prices with a door-to-door delivery_by date per tier; US and EU shipments are DDP. All parameters optional; defaults: 2 layers, 100x100 mm, qty 5.

tools.name: analyze_gerbers
tools.description: Analyze a PCB Gerber .zip (up to 25 MB): detected layers, board size, hole count, DFM findings and a reusable id, from the same engine as the site. Pass exactly one of file_id, file_url or file_base64. With a shell, upload the local zip first with `curl -F file=@board.zip https://pcb.dog/api/analyze

tools.name: find_cost_reductions
tools.description: Find what makes a PCB spec cheaper: re-prices nearby specs (finish, thickness, mask, slower tiers, quantity breaks) from the live tariff and returns the USD savings for a tier (default economy).

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Manufacturing limits, reference stack-ups, accepted quote parameters and DRC rule-file URLs.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Create a PCB order for a Gerber file analyzed with analyze_gerbers (its file_id). Checks the file for production problems, the tier and the shipping address, prices it server-side and returns an order summary: order_id, USD total, delivery_by date, links to a preview of the board and any DFM warning

tools.name: confirm_order
tools.description: Place an order created with create_order, after the person approved its summary. Returns whether pcb.dog accepted the order, with a message for the person: an accepted order carries a payment link for the person to open (the agent never handles card details). Calling it again with the same order_id

tools.name: save_quote
tools.description: Save a pcb.dog quote against an e-mail address so pcb.dog can follow up on it. The server computes the price authoritatively. To order a board, use create_order.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_capabilities, confirm_order · Private data: analyze_gerbers, get_capabilities, create_order · Public sink: analyze_gerbers.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_capabilities, confirm_order · Private data: analyze_gerbers, get_capabilities, create_order · Public sink: analyze_gerbers

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
